title: Lemon-Dill Shrimp and Cucumber Bites
intro: Provides a satisfying hit of lean protein to keep energy steady and easily bridge the gap between meals. Thawing ready-to-eat shrimp under cold water creates an instant, refreshing plate with plenty of crisp crunch.
instructions: Place the frozen shrimp in a colander and run under cold water for 5 to 7 minutes until completely thawed.
Transfer the thawed shrimp to paper towels and pat them thoroughly dry.
Chop the shrimp roughly into small, bite-sized pieces so they will easily balance on the crackers.
Transfer the chopped shrimp to a small bowl and toss with the lemon juice, olive oil, fresh dill, and black pepper.
Arrange the crackers on a serving plate.
Top each cracker with a cucumber round and a spoonful of the herbed shrimp mixture.
variation: Swap the dill for chopped fresh cilantro and a lime squeeze.
conservation: Best enjoyed right away to keep the crackers completely crisp.
